environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a classic ELB configured in TCP passthrough mode on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask application is run via gunicorn with 4 workers, served directly. No additional middleware or proxy filtering is configured. The ELB performs TLS termination but does not inspect HTTP content.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP passthrough mode, TLS termination only
